One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be…
For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long…
All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a…
The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

translations.web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
translations.bsb: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
translations.kjv: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
translations.asv: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.
